_about: Enemy tiers for Forge Campaign, read by forge.campaign.ai.EnemyTiers. An enemy's tier is its entry under 'enemies' (by name in enemies.json); else Boss if enemies.json marks it a boss; else Elite if its life is at least rules.eliteMinLife; else Grunt. Each tier sets an AI profile (res/ai), a simulation mode (none, hybrid, full) and a time budget per decision in milliseconds.
